record.title: Venezuela–Colombia municipal-election restriction at San Antonio, July 2025
record.start_precision: Exact calendar day from local implementation reporting; first refusal clock unverified
record.end_precision: 28 July calendar day with reported 06:00 barrier removal; no independent traffic log
record.scope: Venezuelan-side San Antonio customs access to Simón Bolívar bridge; wider named-bridge reporting is retained without transferring the local operational evidence to every gate.
record.crossings: San Antonio del Táchira customs / Simón Bolívar bridge towards La Parada, Colombia
record.direction: Passage through the Venezuelan-side gate; no independently separated arrival/departure first-passage clocks
record.movement: Ordinary pedestrian and vehicle passage at the San Antonio customs access to Simón Bolívar bridge; medical, ambulance and repatriation passage excepted
record.exceptions: Medical patients towards Colombia, ambulance transfer and coffin repatriation are documented; a complete list of all legal exceptions is not established.
record.enforcement: Local reports describe Saturday restricted passage with a working humanitarian corridor at San Antonio, followed by removal of barriers for ordinary vehicles and pedestrians on Monday 28 July.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: Separate July 2025 municipal-election episode, not the January inauguration, May legislative election or July 2024 presidential-election record; screened against the complete Register/phase union.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_corrections: The earlier 25–28 July instruction concerned strict controls. Local reporting supports ordinary passage being restricted on 26–27 July and returning on 28 July at San Antonio. The two-calendar-day difference is not a measurement of 48 elapsed hours. Medical passage, ambulance transfers and repatriation remained possible. Broader Friday-onset and Monday-night accounts are preserved as conflicting general reports and are not the chronology of this narrowed phase. Other gates, cargo-specific permission and Brazil require separate evidence; geographic coordinates remain unapproved.
record.rationale_coding_status: Source-attributed coding accepted after separate challenge; qualifications retained
record.rationale_phase_note: Codes apply only to their stated phase and attribution; no common primary rationale or complete temporal overlap is presumed.
